0.51.3136:
- Fixed an issue where authenticating in Outlook Express would cause an error on success

- Updated gatekeeper module to track concurrent connections
- Added a mail queue page to RumbleLua and thus also to the Lua API
- Updated rumblectrl with a new --path=<path> arg for creating domains

- Fixed some discovery methods for determining whether emails were read or not
- This symbolic update marks the 0.50 milestone. Future updates may not be compatible with data from 0.50 or below.
- Fixed (I hope) an issue where STARTTLS would crash with "Assertion failed: *lock == MUTEX_UNLOCKED, file ath.c, line 193"
Updated RumbleLua to v0.49

- Fixed some issues where reader/writer locks were blocking each other
- Fixed an issue where POP3 would not properly delete emails

- Fixed an issue where the StartTLS module reported STARTTLS instead of STLS on POP3
- Fixed a crash in the POP3 service when running a UIDL command
- Fixed an issue where POP3 would return an erroneous empty list when running STAT
- Creating a new domain using RumbleLua will now by default create a sub-directory for that specific domain's emails
Moved some of the functions from main.c into separate files

0.48.3080:
- Changed the way delivery failures are described
- Updated RumbleLua so that the mailman service cannot be stopped/started, only paused/resumed.
- The number of delivery attempts and the time in between can now be set in rumble.conf or via RumbleLua
Added smtp_delivery.c
